name: Control Plane
description: Control Plane's official MCP server, letting you deploy containerized apps across AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle Cloud, and your own hardware as one platform. Ship a service and get a live HTTPS URL, add domains, databases, and autoscaling, right size workloads to cut cost, and diagnose failures from live logs, metrics, and events.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Control Plane to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Control Plane to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.cpln.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Control Plane MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Control Plane lists 55 MCP tools, including add_domain_port, add_domain_route, browse_templates, build_image, clear_domain_tls, convert_to_terraform, create_domain, create_gvc, create_identity, create_policy, create_volumeset, and create_workload.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Control Plane?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Control Plane in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Control Plane MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Control Plane requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Control Plane is developed by Control Plane Corporation. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
